description:
Team Bytee is a multidisciplinary group of innovators, storytellers, and space enthusiasts participating in the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge under the Irbid node. Our project, "Abandoned but not Forgotten," bridges the gap between historical space exploration and future generations by turning abandoned lunar and Martian equipment into interactive "Memory Beacons." To bring this cinematic and technical vision to life
